_comment: Configurable rule database for TrafficGuard AI. Edit freely - the Rules page, the rule engine and the API all read this file. Educational use only: legal references and penalties MUST be re-verified against the current official text (https://www.indiacode.nic.in/ and MoRTH notifications) before relying on them. Penalty amounts are intentionally not stored.

rules.violation_name: More Than Two Persons on a Two-Wheeler
rules.description: A two-wheeled motorcycle appears to carry more than one pillion passenger (three or more people seated on the machine).
rules.detection_logic: Count persons whose position is strongly associated with the same two-wheeler (overlap, horizontal alignment, seating height, scale). Flag when 3 or more strong associations exist. 2 strong + 1 ambiguous person produces 'insufficient evidence', not a violation. Video: must persist for several analysed frames.
rules.legal_reference: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 128 (safety measures for drivers and pillion riders of two-wheeled motor cycles); penalty provisions in Section 194C as amended in 2019.
rules.penalty_note: Penalty and licence consequences are set by the Act and state notifications and change over time. Check the current official text; no amount is hard-coded here.

rules.description: The driver of a motorcycle appears not to be wearing a helmet.
rules.detection_logic: Find persons strongly associated with a two-wheeler, take the head region (top ~30% of the person box) and look for a helmet detection there. An explicit no-helmet detection gives a normal-confidence finding; merely not finding a helmet gives a damped, lower-confidence finding. Requires a helmet-labelled YOLO model.
rules.legal_reference: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 129 (wearing of protective headgear); penalty provision in Section 194D.
rules.penalty_note: Exemptions (for example for turban-wearing Sikhs) and penalties are defined in law and may change. Verify against the current official text.

rules.description: A passenger riding behind the driver appears not to be wearing a helmet.
rules.detection_logic: Same head-region search as the rider rule, applied to every strongly associated person other than the driver. Requires a helmet-labelled YOLO model.
rules.legal_reference: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 129 (wearing of protective headgear); penalty provision in Section 194D.
rules.penalty_note: Verify the current penalty and exemptions in the official text.

rules.violation_name: Crossing Stop Line During Red Signal (experimental)
rules.description: A tracked vehicle crosses an operator-defined stop line while the signal is marked red for that time window.
rules.detection_logic: VIDEO ONLY. Signal state is NOT detected by the model: the operator supplies the stop-line position and the red-phase time window. A ByteTrack track whose bottom-centre crosses the line during that window is flagged. A single image can never support this rule.
rules.legal_reference: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - Section 119 (duty to obey traffic signs and signals).
rules.penalty_note: Penalty is set by the Act and state rules. Verify against the current official text.

rules.description: Counts and classifies vehicles (motorcycle, car, bus, truck, bicycle). Not a violation - used for context and the traffic intelligence summary.
rules.detection_logic: COCO-pretrained YOLO detection with duplicate filtering.

rules.description: Wrong-lane driving, lane cutting, wrong-way driving.
rules.detection_logic: Not implemented: requires reliable lane-marking segmentation and road geometry, which neither the dataset nor the models provide.
Not implemented: no plate-labelled dataset was provided. Any future OCR output must be presented as an AI-generated reading, not legal evidence.
